name: How long does the wall insulation installation process usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the wall insulation installation process usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of wall insulation installation depends on several factors, including the size of your home, the type of insulation being installed, and whether it's new construction or a retrofit project. Insulating existing walls typically takes longer than new construction because technicians need to access enclosed wall cavities, often by drilling small holes from the exterior or interior. A smaller project might be completed in a day or two, while a larger, more complex home could take several days. We provide a projected timeline after a site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on home size, insulation type, and project scope (new vs. retrofit). Smaller jobs may take 1-2 days; larger ones several days.
